problem.summary: The merged direct-0.8B launcher reused nested REST estimate/create representations as kwargs to the high-level together-py FineTuningResource.create() method. Current together-py exposes a different Python wrapper contract: Full training is selected with lora=False, SFT with training_method='sft', and train_on_inputs is a top-level SDK argument; training_type is not a create() kwarg.
problem.risk: The pre-repair billed-create call can fail locally with a Python call-shape TypeError. Because the launcher broadly classified create exceptions as UNKNOWN_REMOTE_CREATE after arming its durable intent, a local schema defect could create a false ambiguous-remote lockout even though no fine-tune POST was issued.

one_unusual_experiment.name: SDK_CREATE_SCHEMA_SPLIT_FALSIFIER
one_unusual_experiment.hypothesis: The nested REST training_type/training_method payload used for Together price estimation can also be passed unchanged to the high-level together-py fine_tuning.create() method.
one_unusual_experiment.counterhypothesis: The high-level SDK has a distinct wrapper call schema and converts lora/training_method/train_on_inputs into the nested REST request internally.
one_unusual_experiment.intervention: Compare the exact pre-repair ClayCog create kwargs with the current Together Python FineTuningResource.create signature and implementation, independently of any provider credential or billed request.
one_unusual_experiment.observation: Current create() accepts lora, train_on_inputs and training_method as a string, but no training_type kwarg. Its implementation constructs the nested request and calls estimate_price before POSTing /fine-tunes.

primary_external_evidence.observed_contract: FineTuningResource.create: lora, model_limits, train_on_inputs, training_method string; no training_type kwarg. The wrapper constructs the request, estimates price, then POSTs /fine-tunes.
Current published distribution observed as together 2.28.0 (2026-07-24).

changes: Keep nested training_type/training_method only for REST estimate semantics.
Use high-level together-py create kwargs lora=False, training_method='sft', train_on_inputs='auto'.
Pass already-observed model_limits into create so the wrapper uses the same admitted model-limit object.
Bind inspect.signature(create).bind(**payload) before durable create-intent arming.
Distinguish a deeper local TypeError as LOCAL_SDK_CREATE_REJECTED rather than claiming ambiguous remote CREATE.
Upgrade campaign/create-intent/preflight schema to v3 and bind launcher_sha256 into the campaign fingerprint so an old create confirmation cannot authorize changed launcher bytes.
Pin together==2.28.0 in the PR admission workflow and exercise the installed SDK signature without credentials or provider requests.
